subject: ddl: refactor the args for the DDL type of renametable[wip] (#55959)
summary: Refactors `ActionRenameTable` job args into a typed `model.RenameTableArgs` (with v1/v2 support), updates DDL submission to pass typed args, and switches schema-diff/dependency/scheduler-unique-ID derivation to the new getter so rename-table metadata diffs still work correctly across the two-version rename flow.
